falseSynonyms.zh: 幫助不等於允許 help 表示協助某人完成事情；allow 表示准許或使某事可以發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The teacher helped me finish the task. The teacher allowed me to use a dictionary.

falseSynonyms.zh: 強迫不等於允許 force 表示迫使某人做事，和 allow 的意思相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They forced him to leave. They allowed him to leave.

falseSynonyms.zh: 邀請不等於允許 invite 表示請某人參與或出席；allow 只是表示准許。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She invited me to the meeting. The manager allowed me to attend.

falseSynonyms.zh: 接受不等於允許 accept 表示接受某物、條件或決定；allow 表示准許某項行動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They accepted the proposal. They allowed the work to begin.

falseSynonyms.zh: 使能夠不一定等於正式准許 enable 強調提供能力或條件；permit 強調給予許可。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The software enables remote access. The policy permits remote access.

falseSynonyms.zh: 批准不一定等於所有形式的允許 approve 常用於正式接受計劃或申請；allow 的範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The board approved the plan. The rules allow staff to work from home.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性不同 permission 是名詞；permit 可以是動詞，表示准許。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They gave permission to enter. They permitted us to enter.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可被允許不等於允許某人 allowed 常表示某事獲准；allowable 表示按規則可以接受或容許。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Photography is allowed here. This expense is allowable under the rules.
